name: 6α-oxycodol
summary: 14-Hydroxydihydrocodeine (RAM-318) is an opiate analgesic drug, which is also an active metabolite of oxycodone and hydromorphinol. 14-Hydroxydihydrocodeine is not currently marketed in any developed country, but has been of interest to pharmaceutical companies looking for new analgesics and antitussives.

pharmacology.text: 14-Hydroxydihydrocodeine (RAM-318) is an opiate analgesic drug, which is also an active metabolite of oxycodone and hydromorphinol.

uses.text: 14-Hydroxydihydrocodeine is not currently marketed in any developed country, but has been of interest to pharmaceutical companies looking for new analgesics and antitussives.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, itching, constipation and pinpoint pupils. They can slow or stop breathing, and overdose can be fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、皮膚癢、便秘與瞳孔縮小。它們可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，過量可能致命。長期使用會導致成癮與戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、皮肤痒、便秘与瞳孔缩小。它们可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，过量可能致命。长期使用会导致成瘾与戒断反应。

fact.en: It is one of the compounds the body makes from oxycodone, and it has also been looked at in its own right as a possible painkiller and cough medicine.
fact.zh: 它是身體由羥考酮（oxycodone）代謝出來的化合物之一，本身也曾被研究作為可能的止痛藥與止咳藥。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体由羟考酮（oxycodone）代谢出来的化合物之一，本身也曾被研究作为可能的止痛药与止咳药。
